meta.title: Custom software
meta.description: Brisk builds custom software: client portals, dashboards, automation, integrations and SaaS products. You own the code and the data. Based in Belgium.

hero.title: Software that fits the way you work.
hero.lead: Client portals, dashboards, automation and integrations. We build what off-the-shelf software can't, with code and data that belong to you.
hero.gridLabel: Dashboards and SaaS interfaces designed by Brisk

facts.ownership: You own the code and the design

build.title: Five kinds of software. One way of building.
build.intro: Every project starts with a concrete problem in your business. We then pick the smallest solution that solves it completely, and build it so it can grow.

1.title: Client portals
1.body: A secure place where clients track orders, download files and manage their own details. Fewer emails, fewer phone calls, a clearer picture.

2.title: Dashboards & reporting
2.body: Numbers from all your systems on one screen, live and tailored to whoever is looking. From day-to-day tracking to a monthly report in a single click.

3.title: Process automation
3.body: Repetitive work that still passes through human hands, handled by software instead. Approvals, notifications, scheduling and invoicing run on their own.

4.title: Integrations & APIs
4.body: We connect the systems that currently sit apart: accounting, CRM, webshop, ERP. Data flows automatically and in both directions, with nothing retyped.

5.title: SaaS products
5.body: A product of your own that you sell to customers. From a first version to a multi-tenant platform with subscriptions and payments.

cases.title: Two platforms that run every day.
cases.intro: We built a dedicated platform for each of two players in the chiptuning world. Workshops order, pay and collect their files without anyone having to step in.
cases.shotAlt: {name}, a platform designed and built by Brisk

phases.title: Four phases. No surprises.
phases.body: We split every project into phases, each with a clear scope and price. After each sprint you see working software, not a slide deck. And you decide when the next phase starts.
phases.deliverablesLabel: What the {title} phase leaves you with

1.title: Discovery
1.body: We map your processes, data and systems and pin down exactly what the software has to do.

2.title: Architecture
2.body: Data model, integrations and tech are on paper before anything is built. That keeps the build predictable.

3.title: Build in sprints
3.body: A working version after every sprint that you test yourself and steer as we go.

4.title: Handover
4.body: Code, documentation and access become yours. We stay on hand if you need us.

gallery.title: Screens your team will enjoy using.
gallery.intro: A selection from more than 50 product screens: dashboards, settings, invoicing, email and AI tools. Designed to the pixel, built to be used every day.

stack.title: Proven technology, clear agreements.
stack.intro: We build on a stack we know inside out and that will still be maintained for years to come. No exotic choices, just the right ones.

1.title: Scope and price per phase
1.body: Every phase gets a clear scope and a price up front. You know what you pay before anything is built, and you decide phase by phase whether we continue.

2.title: Your own code and data
2.body: Everything we build is yours: the code, the database, the accounts. No licences, no lock-in, no dependency on us.

3.title: Documentation & handover
3.body: Every project ends with documentation, a handover session and access to everything. Another team can pick it up if that ever becomes necessary.

faq.title: Good to know.
faq.aside: Can't find your question? Email us and you'll hear back within 24 hours.

1.a: It depends on what the software has to do and which systems it talks to. After an analysis of your processes you receive a proposal per phase, with a clear scope and price. You know where you stand up front, and you can start small.

2.q: Do you also build on top of existing systems?
2.a: Yes. Often the smartest thing we can do is add a layer on top of what you already have: a portal on your ERP, a dashboard on your accounting, a link between two tools. We only rebuild when it's genuinely needed.

3.a: Usually we do, on infrastructure such as Vercel and Supabase, on accounts registered in your name. Prefer to host it yourself or with your own provider? That works too: the code is yours either way.

4.a: Software needs maintenance: updates, monitoring and small improvements. We agree on a maintenance plan that matches how critical the software is for your business. Not an obligation, but strongly recommended.

5.a: Absolutely. We like to start with an MVP: the smallest version that solves one problem completely. It goes live quickly, delivers value right away and shows what the next step should be.
